RichPresence.alt: Your profile shows what you're doing in apps like osu!, Jellyfin or AudioBookShelf

RoleColorEverywhere.alt: Role colours show on mentions, the typing indicator and the voice list too

RPCEditor.alt: Any rich presence can be edited, for example turning 'Playing' into 'Listening to' with your own text

SaveFavoriteGIFs.alt: A command saves the links of all your favourite GIFs to a text file

ScheduledMessages.alt: A message you schedule waits as a faded preview and is sent automatically at the set time

SearchFix.alt: Search shows results again instead of the 'We dropped the magnifying glass' error

SecretRingToneEnabler.alt: Incoming calls always play Discord's rare secret ringtone

SedEnhanced.alt: Sending s/old/new edits your last message, with support for full patterns

SekaiStickers.alt: A sticker maker creates character stickers with your own text, curve and size

SelfDestruct.alt: Messages you send with self-destruct on show a red timer and are deleted when it runs out

ServerBackup.alt: A server's channels, roles and permissions are saved to a file that can be restored to another server

ServerListIndicators.alt: The top of the server list shows how many friends are online and how many servers you're in

ServerSearch.alt: A search button at the top of the server list finds a server by name

SharePerms.alt: A window shares chosen permissions with other people for a limited time or number of uses

ShipCalc.alt: The /ship command gives a love score for two people

ShowBadgesInChat.alt: Each message shows its author's profile badges next to their name

ShowConnections.alt: A profile popout lists the person's connected accounts like Steam and Spotify

ShowHiddenThings.alt: Things normally only moderators see, like timeout icons next to members, become visible

ShowMessageEmbeds.alt: Right-clicking a link without a preview offers Show Embeds, which adds the preview

ShowResourceChannels.alt: Channels hidden behind the server's Resources page appear in the channel list

ShowRolesInChat.alt: Each message shows its author's highest role next to their name

ShowSongName.alt: Someone's Spotify activity in the member list shows the song title instead of the artist

ShowTimeoutDuration.alt: A timed-out member shows how much longer their timeout lasts

ShowTypingUsers.alt: The channel header shows a badge listing everyone who is typing

SidebarChat.alt: Another channel or DM opens in a sidebar next to the current chat

Signature.alt: Every message you send ends with your signature line

SilentDelete.alt: A message is swapped for placeholder text and then deleted, so message loggers only keep the placeholder

SilentEdit.alt: Your edited messages show without the (edited) label on your screen

SilentMessageToggle.alt: A button in the chat bar sends your next message silently, without notifications

SmoothUI.alt: Menus, messages and panels open with soft animations

Snowfall.alt: Snow gently falls across the Discord window

SongLink.alt: A song link gets buttons to open the same song on other music services

SongSpotlight.alt: A profile shows a list of favourite songs that can be previewed

SortFriendRequests.alt: Pending friend requests are listed newest first, with the date each arrived

SortReactions.alt: Reactions under a message are reordered from most to fewest

SpaceOut.alt: The /spaceout command puts spaces between every letter of your message

SpotifyActivityToggle.alt: A button turns showing your Spotify listening on your profile on or off

SpotifyCrack.alt: Spotify keeps playing while you talk in voice, and Listen Along works without Premium

SpotifyShareCommands.alt: The /track command shares the Spotify song you're listening to

StartupTimings.alt: A settings page breaks down how long each part of Discord's startup took

StatusPresets.alt: Saved custom statuses can be picked again from a list in one click

StatusWhileActive.alt: Joining a voice channel switches your status automatically, and leaving switches it back

SteamStatusSync.alt: Changing your Discord status changes your Steam status to match

StereoScreenshareAudio.alt: Watching a stream plays its audio in stereo instead of mono

StickerBlocker.alt: Stickers you've blocked no longer show in the chat

StickerPaste.alt: Picking a sticker puts it in the message box so you can add text before sending

StopAutoUnread.alt: A channel's notification setting stays as you chose instead of switching to All Messages by itself

Streaks.alt: Friends you've messaged on several days in a row get a streak counter next to their name

StreamingCodecDisabler.alt: Settings switch off chosen video codecs, like AV1, for streams and cameras

StreamProof.alt: A chat bar button hides messages, images and DMs so they can't be seen on stream

Summaries.alt: AI-written summaries of recent conversations appear in every server

SuperReactionTweaks.alt: The reaction picker defaults to super reactions, and you choose how many play at once

SurfaceTranslate.alt: Channel names and topics in another language are translated into yours

TextScreenshot.alt: A command sends your text as a picture that looks like a Discord message from you

ThemeAttributes.alt: Discord's elements get extra data attributes that themes can use to style them

ThemeLibrary.alt: A library of community themes can be browsed and applied with one click

ThemeStudio.alt: Pick an accent colour, corner roundness and glassy menus, and Discord changes as you go

TidalEmbeds.alt: A TIDAL link gets a player that plays the song inside Discord

Title.alt: The window title shows your own text instead of Discord

ToastNotifications.alt: Messages pop up as small notifications inside Discord, for the kinds of chats you pick

ToggleVideoBind.alt: A keyboard shortcut turns your camera on and off in a call

ToneIndicators.alt: Hovering a tone indicator like /srs shows what it means

TriviaAI.alt: During a trivia game, an AI suggests the answer to the question

TypingIndicator.alt: Channels in the list show typing dots when someone is typing in them

Unindent.alt: Extra indentation at the start of every line in a code block is removed

UnitConverter.alt: Right-clicking a message with measurements offers Convert Units, which shows them in your units

UniversalMention.alt: The mention list offers anyone, even people who can't see the channel

UniversalVolume.alt: Everyone in your voice channel is set to the same volume, including people who join later

UnlimitedAccounts.alt: The account switcher holds more than the usual five accounts

UnlimitedFavoriteGIFs.alt: Favourite GIFs keep saving past Discord's size limit

UnlockedAvatarZoom.alt: The avatar crop tool lets you zoom in much further than usual

UnreadCountBadge.alt: Channels in the list show how many unread messages they have

UnsuppressEmbeds.alt: Right-clicking a message whose link preview was removed offers to bring the preview back

UrlHighlighter.alt: Links that match your patterns are highlighted in messages

UserMessagesPronouns.alt: Each message shows its author's pronouns next to their name

UserPFP.alt: An animated avatar from the UserPFP database shows on profiles and messages without Nitro

UserpluginInstaller.alt: A button installs a user-made plugin straight from its link

UserVoiceShow.alt: A profile shows which voice channel the person is in

USRBG.alt: A profile without Nitro shows a banner picture from the USRBG database

ValidReply.alt: A reply that showed 'Message could not be loaded' shows the original message

ValidUser.alt: Hovering an @unknown-user mention loads the real person behind it

VcNarrator.alt: A narrator voice announces when people join, leave or move voice channels

VCPanelSettings.alt: Voice settings like input volume and noise suppression sit right in the voice panel

VibeCheck.alt: The /vibe command posts a random vaporwave mood

ViewRaw.alt: Right-clicking a message offers View Raw, which shows its raw text and data

VoiceChannelLog.alt: A log lists who joined, left, muted, turned on a camera or shared their screen in a voice channel

VoiceDownload.alt: Voice messages get a download button

VoiceMessages.alt: Right-clicking the upload button records and sends a voice message, like on mobile

VoiceMessagesInBackground.alt: A voice message keeps playing in a mini player while you move to another chat

VoiceRejoin.alt: After Discord restarts, you're put back in the call you were in

WhitelistedEmojis.alt: Emoji in messages are hidden except the ones you've allowed

WigglyText.alt: Text written as ~text~ with arrows around it wiggles in the chat

YoutubeAdblock.alt: YouTube videos in Discord play without ads
